WHATSAPP_HEALTH.TITLE: WhatsApp diagnostics
WHATSAPP_HEALTH.SUBTITLE: Checks with Meta why this inbox does not receive or send messages. Read only: nothing is changed.
WHATSAPP_HEALTH.NEVER: Diagnostics have not been run on this inbox yet.
WHATSAPP_HEALTH.ERROR: Could not run the diagnostics. Please try again.

ACTIONS.SUBSCRIBE_CONFIRM: Our app will be subscribed to the WhatsApp Business account so Meta sends us the messages. Continue?

RECONNECT.BANNER: WhatsApp lost its Meta permission: this inbox does not receive or send messages. Reconnect it to make it work again.
RECONNECT.HINT: The Meta window opens: sign in with the account that manages the business and pick the same number.
RECONNECT.ERROR: Could not reconnect. Please try again.
RECONNECT.SDK_NOT_LOADED: The Meta window did not load. Reload the page and try again.
RECONNECT.APP_BROKEN: The system Meta app is misconfigured: ask the system administrator to fix it in Super Admin.

STATE.NOT_NEEDED: The inbox is connected: reconnecting is not needed. Do it only if support asks you to or if the Meta account that manages the number changed.
STATE.NEEDED: Meta rejected this inbox permission: reconnecting fixes it.
STATE.UNKNOWN: Use it if the Meta permission expired or the Meta account that manages the number changed. Run the diagnostics to know if it is needed.

ERRORS.WINDOW_24H: More than 24 h since the customer last wrote: use a template.
ERRORS.NOT_ON_WHATSAPP: The customer number has no WhatsApp or cannot receive the message.
ERRORS.PAYMENT: Payment issue on the WhatsApp Business account.
ERRORS.ECOSYSTEM: Meta held the message to protect the customer (too many marketing messages).
ERRORS.UNSUPPORTED: That message type is not allowed.
ERRORS.TEMPLATE: Template problem (parameters, paused, rejected or deleted): {title}
ERRORS.RATE_LIMIT: Too many messages in a row; retrying slower.
ERRORS.TOKEN: The Meta permission expired: reconnect the inbox in Settings → Inboxes → Diagnostics.
ERRORS.BLOCKED: The account or number is blocked by Meta.

REPORT.COPIED: Diagnostics copied: paste them in your support request.
